When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of Glory dy'd,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.
Watts printed the hymn under Galatians 6:14. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world. GALATIANS 6:14 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ GALATIANS 6
Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast, Save in the death of Christ my God; All the vain things that charm me most, I sacrifice them to his blood. STANZA II
